summary: The cap-area continuity and quantile-attainment arguments are valid, including support-face cases. Choosing a maximizer of the support functional on A_2 and applying the strict depth hypothesis to the corresponding lower halfplane correctly yields q(lambda) + beta(lambda) < lambda(z). Summing over a zero-sum triple gives the claimed strict negative bound and hence incompatibility with the accepted predecessor inequality. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
